faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Tirupathur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the DCPU Tirupathur Recruitment 2026 is 25th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Assistant Cum Bench Clerk post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Assistant Cum Bench Clerk position, candidates must have passed SSLC (Class 10) or its equivalent. Proficiency in computers is mandatory, and preference will be given to those with a typing certificate in Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the DCPU Tirupathur recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts announced under the DCPU Tirupathur Recruitment 2026 is 42 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies are available in this recruitment drive. These vacancies are for the posts of Junior Assistant Cum Bench Clerk and Office Assistant, with one vacancy for each post.

faq.answer: The application mode for the DCPU Tirupathur Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.answer: The salary offered for the Office Assistant post is 13000 per month. This is a contractual position, and the salary is as per the terms and conditions of the District Child Protection Unit Tirupathur.
